title: Readiness panel composition with sub-tabs (FBS-206, TAC-4135)
description: Renders the SubTabStrip (Overview, Questions, Blocking, Coverage, Trace) and five sub-panels; composes the Overview sub-view (tree line, verdict cards, verdict grid, delta counts, decisions, freeze state, freeze record), the Questions / Blocking / Coverage sub-views by composing the FBS-204 / 205 tables and the Trace shell for FBS-208. Removes the For-engineers DocRow wrapper and the stage-chips / stage-detail blocks; renders the freeze state in plain words with the On me / On engineers vocabulary and names what resolves each failing gate (AC-18005-2, -4, -5, -8).
